case_caption: Elon Musk et al. v. Samuel Altman et al.
scope_note: Primary docket archive runs through May 3, 2026 (entry #522). Trial began April 27, 2026 and is bifurcated under PTO #4 (#477) into liability (Apr 28 – ~May 15) and remedies (~May 18+) phases. Per PTO #3 (#456), disgorgement is an equitable remedy decided by the Court, not the jury. Day-by-day trial coverage is in case-files/ trial-wiki commentary, treated as secondary observation. Live claims after the Jan 15, 2026 MSJ ruling (#390): 4 vs OpenAI defendants (charitable trust, fraud, constructive fraud, unjust enrichment) + 1 vs Microsoft (aiding and abetting fiduciary breach) = 5 total.
